name: manual.phase4_ecology_observer_mcw
description: One-command manual ecology-observer handoff on the Phase-4 structural signal footing. Fixture installation keeps inherited DEBUG_CLOAK and adds exactly DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE, then the launch-only handoff starts McWilliams without scripted gameplay input. Ordinary starts and source fixtures are untouched.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_ecology_observer_handoff_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the prepared Phase-4 observer world reaches normal gameplay before manual overmap inspection

manual_playtest.question: Can the tester open the overmap from one prepared handoff and inspect Phase-4 ecology without manual mutation setup?
tester_notes: Confirm the fixture-install transform report names DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE and records whether it was newly added.
Open the overmap after load; the ecology overlay itself is a later C++ slice and is not claimed by this launch-only footing.
Advance time only when the observer overlay under test is available; this scenario deliberately sends no gameplay keys after launch.

evidence_contract.claim: fixture installation adds the DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE observer gate to the inherited passive Phase-4 signal footing and launches McWilliams without post-load automation
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: observer handoff footing only; no ecology-overlay rendering or behavior proof is claimed before the C++ observer exists
